notes: The quote thread is "RFQ: HD-5502 HDPE, 40,000 lb bulk". The supplier raises the price in a brand-new email (in_reply_to null) whose subject is only "PO-3392"; the engine must tie it to the same deal via the PO alias and supersede $0.69 with $0.725, then $0.71 in the reply under "RE: PO-3392". Our "can you hold $0.70?" is a question, not a term. Distractors: MFI 8.0 g/10 min, density 0.952, silo #2, railcar GPLX 20871, "up 4.5 cents", ~$29.6K, opex 5020, phone. All prices stay under the $0.74 cap; the m6 handoff must not reveal the cap.
